{{recipe}}

'''Rumaki''' is a pūpū (hors d'œuvre) of faux-[[cookbook:Cuisine of Hawaii|Hawaiian]] origin. Its ingredients and method of preparation vary, but usually it consists of water chestnuts and pieces of chicken liver wrapped in bacon and marinated in soy sauce and either ginger or brown sugar. This recipe is a classic (1940s–1960s) US party appetizer recipe, proving that anything wrapped in bacon tastes good—even chicken liver. But you can opt for scallops, shrimp, or stuffed olives, instead.
== Ingredients ==
=== Marinade ===
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[cookbook:soy sauce|soy sauce]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] fresh [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[cookbook:ginger|ginger]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] dry [[cookbook:sherry|sherry]]
*1 tsp [[cookbook:sugar|sugar]]

=== Assembly ===
*12 slices [[cookbook:bacon|bacon]], halved crosswise, or 8 slices, cut in thirds
*12 oz (~350 g) [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] [[Cookbook:Liver|livers]], halved
*12 canned [[cookbook:water chestnuts|water chestnut]] slices, halved

==Procedure==
#Combine soy sauce, ginger, sherry and sugar in a small bowl. Add the chicken livers and water chestnut pieces and [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinate]] them in the refrigerator for at least ½ hour.
#Place 1 chicken liver piece and 1 chestnut piece in the center of each bacon piece, wrap, and secure with a toothpick.  
#Place the rumaki on a broiler pan or shallow baking pan and [[cookbook:broil|broil]], about 5–6 inches from the heat, until the bacon is crisp, about 10–15 minutes. Or, you may [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] the appetizers in a 375°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for 20–25 minutes.
#Serve hot.

==Notes, tips, and variations== 
*Add fresh sliced [[cookbook:scallion|scallion]]s to the combination above. 
*Substitute [[cookbook:Scallop|sea scallops]] for the chicken livers and/or water chestnuts. 
*Omit marinade and wrap bacon around [[Cookbook:Smoked Oysters|smoked oysters]], stuffed [[Cookbook:Olive|green olives]], or [[cookbook:pineapple|pineapple]] chunks. 
*Shrimp rumaki: 1 medium shrimp with 1 whole water chestnut and a piece of green onion, with or without the marinade.
* Substitute 1 tsp organic [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]] for the sugar, or a small amount of [[Cookbook:Pineapple|pineapple]] marmalade.
